name: Prepare the field
tip: Clear the land, make ridges and add compost or manure.

name: Plant with the first good rains
tip: Plant when the soil is wet a hand deep.

name: Put in basal fertilizer
tip: (depends on the farmer's plan) Use part of your fertilizer at planting, close to the seed and covered.
notes: The app personalises this tip with the farmer's planned bags of fertilizer.

name: First weeding
tip: Weeds take water and food from young maize.

name: Top-dress with urea
tip: Put it near each plant when the soil is moist, then cover it.

name: Second weeding
tip: Keep the field clean until the maize is tall.

name: Harvest when the cobs are dry
tip: The husks turn brown and the cobs hang down. Do not leave dry cobs in the field.

name: Sort out mouldy and broken grain
tip: Mouldy grain can carry aflatoxin. Do not eat, sell or feed it to animals.

name: Dry and store the grain
tip: Dry until the grain cracks when bitten, then store in a sealed bag.
